_about: A model of who gets access to the SalesDW warehouse and the Sales semantic model. For each person set workspace_role (null, Viewer, Contributor, Member or Admin), warehouse (null for no share, or a list of the warehouse permissions listed) and semantic_model (null, or a list of the model permissions listed). A share always includes Read, so list Read in every share. Give each person the least access that works.

Hana.needs: Finance analyst in another workspace. Reads every table and view in SalesDW with T-SQL from SQL Server Management Studio. Needs nothing else in the workspace.

Ivo.needs: Data scientist in another workspace. Reads the SalesDW Delta files with Spark from his own notebooks. He never uses T-SQL.

Jun.needs: Auditor. Connects to SalesDW and reads only the two views the DBA grants her with a T-SQL GRANT.

Kai.needs: Report author in another workspace. Builds new reports on the Sales model and analyzes it in Excel. The model is in import mode, so his reports never query SalesDW.

Lia.needs: Sales manager. Opens the existing reports built on the Sales model and uses Explore on them. Builds nothing new and doesn't share the model.

Max.needs: Data engineer joining the Sales team. Loads new tables into SalesDW with T-SQL every night.
